info.title: HMV Global CMS API
info.description: Admin API (`/api/v1/admin/*`, `/api/v1/auth/*`) uses an HttpOnly session cookie set by `POST /auth/login` (`hmv_session`, or `__Host-hmv_session` in production) plus the `X-CSRF-Token` header on every write. Public API (`/api/v1/public/*`) is read-only and serves published content only. Errors always have the shape `ErrorResponse`; branch on `code`.

csrfToken.description: Send back as the `X-CSRF-Token` header on every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE.

details.description: Code-specific detail, e.g. [{ path, message }] for validation errors

url.description: Public URL of the stored object.

altTexts.description: Default alt text per locale. Usages (article cover, inline images) may override it.

altText.description: Default alt text for this locale. `null` or "" removes it.

contexts.description: Whether the referencing revision is the current draft, the published one, or both.

inUse.description: True when a current draft or published revision references the asset. Such assets must not be deleted.

historicalRevisionCount.description: Older revisions that still reference the asset (kept for history).

reviewStatus.description: APPROVED when a reviewer approved exactly this content (any edit resets it).

isLive.description: The locale is served by the public API.

hasUnpublishedChanges.description: The draft differs from what the public sees (always true when not live).

isOutdated.description: The source locale changed after this translation was made.

hasUnpublishedChanges.description: Published, and the draft has moved past the published revision.

revision.description: Current draft revision number. Send it back as `expectedRevision`.

updatedBy.description: Author of the current draft revision.

awaitingReview.description: Non-archived with at least one draft translation that is not approved (same rule as `awaitingReview=true`).

featured.description: Non-archived with the featured flag set on the current draft.

slug.description: Lowercase ASCII words joined by single hyphens. Unique per locale across all articles. Required when adding a locale.

content.description: Tiptap/ProseMirror JSON, rich content schema v1. Nodes: doc, paragraph, text, heading(level 2|3), blockquote, bulletList, orderedList, listItem, codeBlock, hardBreak, horizontalRule, image(mediaId required; src is ignored on input and resolved on output). Marks: bold, italic, strike, underline, code, link(href http/https/mailto/tel or site-relative). Max 256 KiB.

coverImageAlt.description: Alt text for the cover image in this locale. Falls back to the asset's default alt.

sourceLocale.description:
Declares this translation was produced from another locale of the same draft; the server records that locale's
current content hash so later source edits flag this translation as outdated. `null` clears it.
